[26.1 版本移植信息](https://wiki.chaotictrials.de/porting/version/26.1/) **[![#与乌克兰站在一起](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshymanskyy/StandWithUkraine/main/banner2-direct.svg)](https://vshymanskyy.github.io/StandWithUkraine)** ![标题图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/header.png)
![概览图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/overview.png)
![创造模式标签页](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/creative_tab.png) 元素锄/多功能工具不仅能创造耕地，还能创造*超级耕地*。它无需水源，即使踩踏也不会退化为泥土。还有那些粉色闪光效果，*太惊艳了*！关于单个物品的详细信息可在**植物魔法辞典**中查阅。 ![超级耕地预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/super_farmland_preview.gif)
![合成配方](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes.png)
点击展开 **元素多功能工具** ![元素多功能工具配方](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/elementium_aiot.png) **活石剪刀** ![活石剪刀配方](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/livingrock_shears.png) **活木剪刀** ![活木剪刀配方](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/livingwood_shears.png)
您可以将此模组加入任意整合包中。 ![[广告](https://www.bisecthosting.com/melanx)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/promo.png) #广告 #推广
